reason_current_route_is_sufficient_condi: The constrained launcher pins both CWD and ShellExecute lpDirectory to the runtime. The ASI has only relative database/Master paths or module-derived paths, and the exact runtime process identity plus a Native07-only UI record proves the patched Editor loaded the isolated candidate. This avoids using post-write equality of the original as the safety boundary.
